notes.content:
After a couple weeks of debugging, we’re finally making public the corrected build that replaces the revert from earlier this month. The patch primarily addresses the root cause of the disappearing TOZ34 and related strange behavior related to saving/loading. Here’s what went wrong:
In multiple scenes, notably Arcology, Apartment, and Memorial Tower, some items were disappearing or behaving erratically. The list of items isn’t long and would probably slip under the radar, but one of the affected items was the TOZ34, both a starting item in the first level and a popular gun among Peri’s numerous hobos. The symptom was primarily the gun disappearing on load, out of Marie’s hands and those of enemies – leading to their AI becoming confused and numerous null reference errors clogging up the log and hogging memory.

Obviously, you’d think the issue was with some change to the save system, which is still the focus of our endeavors to improve the player experience. After numerous internal builds, git reverts and combing through log files and specific commit changes, and cursing, we discovered that the issue was in fact not any of our code, but rooted in how Unity handles serialized prefab references in scenes. Under the hood, the issue can be summarized thus:
[list]
[*] Unity retained stale prefab references, often replacing base prefab references with their variant equivalents in scene files. 
[*] Unity’s serialization didn’t report anything wrong in the editor.
[*] But builds failed to include the proper prefab GUIDs, causing dictionary lookups, save data, and runtime instantiation to break.
[*] This issue didn’t show up in-editor unless thoroughly recreated, making it extremely painful to track down.
[/list]
All affected scenes were manually corrected to restore proper prefab linkage. To prevent future situations like that, we’ve added internal checks during build to detect broken prefab lists and duplicate PIDs. A build will now throw a warning if it detects that base prefabs are missing or duplicated.

[b]Important note to other developers:[/b]
If you’re working with nested prefab variants in Unity: touch your scenes. Merging scene files from different branches without saving them in the editor afterward may cause corruption that will silently make it into builds. Unity doesn’t always update what it should unless you explicitly tell it to.
[b]Important note to players:[/b]
If you made a save in build 20250703.16370, 20250627.15469 or 20250626.22303, the TOZ will likely not reappear in the affected scenes. Please load a previous save or restart the level if that’s the case for you.

Anyway, back to our regularly scheduled updates. This version restores all the fixes and changes introduced before the revert (and, of course, the TOZ34) and also includes the following additions:
[list]
[*] Added an option for crouch toggle
[*] Made the hot slot bar behave better in 4:3 aspect ratio resolutions
[*] [REC] Made the save room mechanic more explicit
[/list]
Our patrons and backers are currently playing around with a cool new feature we’ll be showing off this Screenshot Saturday. Once we gather enough feedback and make sure it won’t cause any issues, it will become available to the public.

Thank you again for your patience.

notes.content:
As new content and mechanics are still in the oven (Topie Chan will return soon!), we continue to improve and tweak the current experience – just in time for the Summer Sale! Players both new and old, here’s the changes you can expect:

[list]
[*] Quick saving/loading can’t be done in menu anymore (particularly important for not accidentally loading)
[*] You can no longer save while in midair or reloading, it will instead be queued up (assuming you don't go splat on the ground)
[*] Inventory item values (uses/ammo counts) don’t disappear on save anymore
[*] NPCs "speak" during conversations again
[*] Gas grenade clouds shouldn't continue to deal damage after loading a save
[*] Fixed glitch causing melee weapons to instakill enemies while sprinting with a specific set of inputs
[*] Grenades and nade-like objects should be less buggy (still working on this)
[*] Fixed some weapons going pink when using thermoptic. Interestingly enough, sword and nade were fucked in completely different ways, leading to the same result.
[*] Large batteries can’t drop limb health below zero anymore
[*] Added precautions against the elusive “APS spikes become huge“ bug. Still not sure why they occasionally decide to fill half of a room
[*] Weapons shortened with the hacksaw (as well as the hacksaw itself) should save properly
[*] You can't change firing mode while hacking anymore
[*] The Map Drone can now be detected by NPCs if you knock one out with it
[*] Disabled saves on arena since it wasn't supposed to have them
[*] Improved the shader for cloaked items in third person
[*] Improved character meshes (including armbands and new gasmasks)
[*] Camera zoom function can be reassigned to different keys now
 [*] Added “Next Hotslot” and “Previous Hotslot” keymappings (defaults are brackets)
[*] Added the option to map mouse scrollwheel input (used for camera zoom as default but can be assigned for switching hotslots a’la Deus Ex… or bunnyhopping)
[*] Fixed cassette playback glitching out on Sunday Summer
[*] [APT] Third Hallway Weirdo selection box won’t glitch out
[*] [APT] Kasia’s bathroom door is now corporeal (ya creep)
[*] [APT] Removed vestigial sound effects and improved particle effects
[*] [KAR] Made funicular in factory lab not lock Marie’s rotation
[*] [KAR] Removed duplicate elevator panel in apartments
[*] You can’t claim a speedrun world record on Chasm with a goddamn debug cheat anymore
[*] New outfit in the cheat menu
[*] Renamed some of the levels to not cause confusion with real world places, which only inspired them 
[/list]

notes.content:
Thanks everyone for helping us with your bugreports, makes our job much more pleasant. [b]List of fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Adjustments made to the cost of implants.
[*] Several items in missions would disappear when you loaded a saved game from main menu (particularly bad on Belgrade with several of the first guns you can find being affected), this was caused by a discrepancy in their save profiles compared to their prefabs: corrected this systematically
[*] Some consumables weren't saving their hotslot number which is why they weren't going back to slots if you used them and reloaded.
[*] Belgrade had a several second window (the duration of the opening cutscene) where you could drop your implants and pick them up before they were removed from your inventory.
[*] There's been several reported crashes that have been revealed to be caused by a ragdoll stretching out indefinitely. While the exact cause of this crash is unknown, there is now a failsafe that gets tripped when you load a save from main menu and a corpse is showing signs of stretching his arms out (just for you). This at least should stop the bug from persisting on most save files.
[/list]

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Update
notes.content:
Wow, what a week! The Steam Next Fest is almost over, thank you EVERYONE that wishlisted the game, played the demo, [url=https://90s.graphics/discord]joined the Discord to leave feedback[/url], commented on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1437760/discussions/]Steam forums[/url], tweeted out screenshots, [url=https://twitter.com/90sGraphics]drew fanart[/url], streamed the game, made videos, took screenshots and [url=https://streamable.com/fzguzk]attempted speedruns[/url]. There’s thousands of you and it’s been both a very humbling and encouraging experience for our team of 3 people and our contributors.

Many of you have noticed: there’s been a lot of updates over the week. We have been applying hotfixes, tweaks and patches daily. We have to admit: the demo you saw on Monday was very buggy, but thanks to your reports and a lot of work, the demo has achieved a level of quality we are close to proud of and hopefully you’ll find enjoyable over the coming months, as we won’t be taking it down. We’re still ironing out bugs and we’ll keep updating it, so please keep telling us your thoughts and sharing insights and suggestions.

For those who played the demo in its broken state and are planning to return to it, here’s a general patchnote:

[list]
[*] Added a clearer description to the Puppeteer implant.
[*] Added new areas to the Tutorial.
[*] Added new quest logs.
[*] Android does not collide with random invisible walls.
[*] Augmentation UI should not cause a continuous sine wave tone.
[*] Consumable items have been fixed.
[*] Fall damage has been lowered.
[*] Fixed flame damage on enemies.
[*] Fixed inventory wipe on save.
[*] Fixed issues with activating implants on load after death.
[*] Fixed issues with inventory items not saving.
[*] Fixed priest conversation.
[*] Fixed the main menu for ultrawide resolutions.
[*] Fixed transparent textures not working with raycasts (e.g. gunshots).
[*] Headshot now work as intended.
[*] Improved reliability of the light meter.
[*] Improved the intended “first time player” tutorial guidance.
[*] Instances of floating magazines removed, they can’t be “stolen” from enemy guns either.
[*] Inventory no longer activates during hacking, neither do you switch to third person.
[*] Issues with loading after death have been addressed.
[*] Items do not appear as “duplicated” inside containers.
[*] Mosin sights have been fixed.
[*] Night vision has been remade.
[*] NPC behavior on load mostly fixed.
[*] Resolved issue with receiving quest items from NPCs after load.
[*] Save menu works reliably.

notes.title: Peri Kickstarter: interrogation mechanic unlocked!
notes.content:
[h1]Fifth goal: interrogation mechanics unlocked![/h1]

We’ve got 12 days to go, and the Kickstarter for PERIPETEIA was able to reach 180% funding! Thanks to you, we’ll be able to add Splinter-Cell and Metal Gear style interrogation dialogue and mechanics to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39205791/19d1b7edb85aa9d183c47811f324b4a6ea85f92b.png[/img]

Sneak up on your enemies and take them hostage. Learn valuable intel, or simply have a friendly little chat. As a field operative with unlimited freedom, Marie deserves a truly skillful non-lethal move. An action executable without any equipment, but only possible to pull off on unsuspecting enemies. Essential for the players that want to play the game in a more sneaky manner.

[h1]Goal #6: Selected Voiced Dialogue[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39205791/b07370ac045b08ddf32ea443ca07481d4c0e552a.jpg[/img]

At €21k / $24.8k, we put voices to some of our most important NPCs and dialogues; giving them stronger characterisation and helping to build Peri's already deep atmosphere.

PERIPETEIA's world is an unforgiving and surreal place, filled with ruthless, scarred and broken people. Help us bring those characters a little more to life, and set the scene, by giving important lines the perfect delivery.

[h2]Don't forget to check out our full campaign and rewards![/h2]

Don't forget to stop in and have a look what rewards you could receive by backing [url=90s.graphics/ks]PERIPETEIA's Kickstarter[/url]. There are still 12 days left in the campaign and lots to come! 

Feel free to check out our [url=90s.graphics/discord]discord[/url] and play our [url=90s.graphics/steam]demo[/url] too. Let us know what you think!

Cheers,
The 9th Exodus Team

notes.title: PERIPETEIA: Now 78%+ funded!
notes.content:
[h1]Home Stretch![/h1]

We're already nearly funded and it's been less than two days!

Thankyou everyone who has backed us so far: your generosity is deeply appreciated, and vital to helping us finish the game.

[h2]Patching the demo[/h2]

We've been working hard today to patch some issues with yesterday's Kickstarter demo, and we're releasing that right... [b]NOW.[/b]

[h2]Frequently ask questions[/h2]

We've had some questions about backer rewards and stretch goals so, we thought we'd just address those here. We'll keep answering questions as they come in, both here, on our [url=90s.graphics/twitter]Twitter[/url], on [url=90s.graphics/KS]Kickstarter[/url] and on [url=90s.graphics/discord]our Discord[/url]. Please drop in and talk to us, we're friendly (honest)!

[h3]1. The DVD version of the game: full DRM free or steam installer?[/h3]

A: The DVD will contain a DRM-free release build of the game.

[h3]2. If DRM free, will we be releasing patches?[/h3]

A: Yes, there will be patches or new builds available via Itch.io or indie.db for which you'll get a key.

[h3]3. Is the DVD going have the soundtrack in some form too?[/h3]

A: Yes, if we can fit it on there.

[h3]4. Is the soundtrack going be a Bandcamp download or steam DLC?[/h3]

A: Steam for the MP3 version of the soundtrack. Bandcamp for the high-quality FLAC version.

[h3]5. How is the Generous Secretary "help us design a level" perk going to work?[/h3]

A: Backers from the Generous Secretary tier will be allowed to contribute ideas, concepts, encounters, dialogue, NPCs; anything that goes into the design of a Peri-style level (within reason!). We will then take those ideas, and work with the Generous Secretaries to shop those ideas into a complete, large-size Peripetia level. We're very excited about this one because we love a challenge, and love weird and wonderful ideas, and combining them in interesting ways. Why settle for having an in-game "backer room" in your game when you can have an entire "backer level" that's completely playable and fits neatly into the theme of the game. 

[h3]6. How do I get my special backer discord role?[/h3]

A: Originally we were going to hand out rewards like the discord roles once the KS ended, but we're happy to assign them now. KS unfortunately does not support an automatic role assignment integration with Discord, so please drop by our discord and show us a screenshot, and we'll have you looking down upon the un-contributing masses in no time.

[h3]7. What will/can the "LORE SNIPPET" be?[/h3]

A: We'll leave the exact implementation to our discretion, but we're encouraging you to write newspaper clippings, readable sections from books, government documents, or even item descriptions. If you have a fun idea how to flesh out the background worldbuilding of the game, share it! Our frob system allows for most objects to have an additional description attached to them (zooming on weapons or posters in the fourth level are an example of that), we'll have Deus Ex-style readable objects as well.

notes.title: PERIPETEIA will be Kickstarting soon!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=m726CTCucx4;full][/previewyoutube]

PERIPETEIA fans!

We're ecstatic to announce that Peripeteia will be launching its Kickstarter Campaign very soon! We'll be going live on August 14th 2021 8AM PT: followed by an appearance as part of the Realms Deep Live Show 2021!

[b]New Demo[/b]

Along with this announcement, we've been working on a new and improved demo for you to try and see for yourself before backing. This is a new and improved version that has taken multiple rounds of your feedback into account, and offers nearly double the content of the last one. We hope you enjoy it.

Included in the Kickstarter Demo is:

- The improved tutorial mission in the perpetual night of the Underpass District.
- A visit to Marie's new apartment and in-game shooting range.
- A trip to the rain-soaked, revamped Memorial Tower, to pull off a high-profile assassination.
- An epic-length, multi-pathed, explosive exploration mission across a full-blown warzone at "The Chasm".
- Numerous improvements to the feel and flow of the game.
- A non-proverbial arsenal of guns to play with.
- A cactus you can talk to.

[b]What can I expect in terms of backer rewards and stretch goals?[/b]

The full details of each reward tier and funding goal will be revealed when the Kickstarter goes live,
but here's an incomplete preview of the kinds of things you can expect:

- Both digital and physical goodies like high-quality artworks and soundtrack.
- Exclusive access to preview builds of the game and being able to influence what we include.
- Stretch goals like contributions from talented, well-known artists and musicians.

[b]Why Kickstarter?[/b]

Money can be exchanged for goods and services, which unfortunately our (for the time being) flesh-and-blood development team require to continue being alive. Working on Peripeteia is a full-time job, and the Kickstarter will give us the small living allowance needed to keep making the game. We make as many models, textures, sounds and other assets ourselves if we can. This is not only because we want a look and feel that is unique to PERIPETEIA, but also to keep our development budget as small as possible.

[b]When is PERIPETEIA going to release?[/b]

PERIPETEIA is going to release in Late 2022.

[b]Where can I see the Kickstarter when it goes live?[/b]

We'll make another annoucement at the time with all the links and details but when it does go live, you can find the Kickstarter here:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/shodanon/peripeteia]90s.graphics/KS[/url]


Please stay tuned for our official announcement in the next 1.5 days, and we look forward to seeing you play the new demo!

Cheers,
The 9th Exodus Team
